params.message:
One of each: labels, region counting, source kind, save

PHASE_META and MODEL_LABELS lived in Analytics and in ModelRouting; the Analytics copy
had fallen behind and printed ? for Opus 5 and Fable 5 usage rows. They are now
src/models.js, and Analytics uses the same labelFor.
The country-to-region map and the counting loop lived in Insights and Patterns; now
countByRegion in taxonomy.js. classifyPlatform lived in Insights and SourceDistribution;
now src/platforms.js. PLATFORM_COLORS was unused.
ReviewQueue kept its own storePatch that never checked the response, so a failed save
moved on to the next insight as if it had been saved. It uses the one in useData now,
which throws, and the queue stays on the item.
